A run of a listed program goes ahead without asking when its file matches the recorded fingerprint. A first or changed program, and runs in your folders or with files, still ask you every time. Shells, interpreters and launchers your vault recognizes by name still ask every time. Other programs that can run commands, such as git or npm, do not.
%1$s can run other commands given in its arguments, so the agent could use it to run any command with your secret. Asking before each run is safer for it.
